resources.string: Notifications are mirrored to the web app while it is open. Nothing is stored on the controller.
Allow Notification access to see, dismiss and reply to this phone\'s notifications from the web app.
If the switch is greyed out (app not installed from a store): open App info, tap ⋮ and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Apps appear here once they post a notification. Turn an app off to keep its notifications on this phone only.
